product.title: Reputation & the Long Game
product.summary: A two-round negotiation where round one's reputation sets round two's starting position.
product.whatStudentsDo: Not yet runnable. As designed, students pick a role and a horizon, negotiate one round using a chosen signal and decide whether to follow through on a bluff, then open a second negotiation whose starting position reflects the trust and credibility they built or spent.
